easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.
